newsitem.title: UK: Shield buys heart, immune diagnostic firm.
newsitem.headline: Shield buys heart, immune diagnostic firm.

text.p: British health technology company Shield Diagnostics Plc said on Wednesday it had acquired a portfolio of diagnostic tests focused on cardiovascular and immune system diseases.
In a statement, Shield said it had paid 2.4 million stg for TTP Corp, a subsidiary of Murex Diagnostics Corp, which owns intellectual and other rights to ten established diagnostic products.
Shield said the tests would fit in with its existing range of diagnostic products.

Shield, which is developing a test to predict propensity to heart attacks, said it had also entered a manufacturing and distribution agreement with Murex, which is part of International Murex Technologies Corp.

"Murex will be able to access additional products in the Shield portfolio and Shield will have access to Murex's distribution network, thereby considerably improving our direct sales capabilities in Europe and North America," managing director Gordon Hall said.
